purpose: Teach: 賑わい/背骨/減価/声高/子女/食い違い/異に/突っ込ま

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、賑わい、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on the bustling life of the Edo period was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, steady recognition. Gentle emphasis on Ren's name at the start. Unhurried delivery. The tone of a teacher genuinely seeing a student's effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代人の、本気で、絶対、背骨、絶対、研究、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to make the research on ancient peoples' histories thorough and deep.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slight nervous energy underlying the gratitude—he means this. Steady eye contact. Respectful but genuine, not formal.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 資産の、本気で、絶対、減価、絶対、償却、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled asset depreciation through history showed such breadth of vision. Really thoughtful work.
lines.style: Appreciative, slightly thoughtful pause before 'breadth.' Measured pace. The admiration is specific and earned, not generic praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦前の、本気で、絶対、声高、絶対、な議論、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to examine the heated prewar debates thoroughly, to really understand the depth.
lines.style: Respectful nod in his voice. Earnest but not self-conscious. A bit careful—he's acknowledging the weight of what he studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 貴族の、本気で、絶対、子女、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of noble education was striking. You noticed things other students might have missed.
lines.style: Engaged and present. A slight lift in warmth—she's clearly delighted by this particular section. Clear enunciation, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。記録の、本気で、絶対、食い違い、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really wanted to dig into the discrepancies in the historical records—that was the heart of it.
lines.style: Focused intensity. Small, determined edge—he's explaining what mattered to him. Not defensive, but invested. Slight lean-forward energy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学派が、本気で、絶対、見解を、絶対、異に、絶対、する、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced how different schools of thought diverged in their interpretations—that's exactly the kind of critical thinking we need.
lines.style: Clear admiration with intellectual warmth. Deliberate pacing on 'different schools.' She's recognizing intellectual maturity, not just effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市場が、本気で、絶対、突っ込ま、絶対、れた、絶対、状況、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to show how the market pressures created those shifts in thinking. It felt important to connect everything.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath. Earnest closure—he's satisfied with what he discovered. Soft, firm finality. The conviction of having worked deeply.
